FAQs
What time is check-in and check-out?
Check in is from 3pm and check out is at 12pm
What facilities and services are available at Haymarket Hotel?
24 hour room service
Concierge
Guest Drawing Room and Conservatory
Restaurant and Bar
Swimming pool
Private Dining and Meeting Rooms
Gym
Body and beauty treatment room
Valet
Fully air conditioned
What in-room amenities do you offer?
Writing Desk
Flat Screen LCD TV
Tivoli Radio
Bose SoundLink
High speed wireless internet access
Fully stocked Mini Bar
Bed linen by Firmdale Sleep
RikRak bath & body products
Chromecast
Two line telephones with voicemail
Personal safe
Do you cater for families and children?
Yes, we are family-friendly and have tailored amenities available for children at Haymarket Hotel:
Cots
High chairs
Babysitting
Children's menus
Children's books and board games
Milk & cookies at bedtime
Mini bathrobes
Bathroom amenities for babies and children
Welcome gift to suit the child's age
Swimming Pool
Are you a dog-friendly hotel?
Yes, all dogs are welcome to stay at Haymarket Hotel. However, only guide dogs are permitted in our restaurant.
Are there any special offers available for stays in London?
Yes, our special offers change regularly. With reduced rates and exciting extras, they are the perfect way to make the most of a luxury hotel suite escape or weekend city break near London theatres. Explore our latest offers here.
What dining and bar experiences can I find at Haymarket Hotel?
Brumus is our elegant modern British restaurant at Haymarket Hotel, in the heart of London’s theatre district. Our menus are centred around modern British cuisine, featuring elevated classics and seasonal specials. From business lunches and luxury pre-theatre dining, to a London landmarks-inspired Afternoon Tea , we have designed menus for all-day dining near Trafalgar Square and Piccadilly.
Located in the heart of the West End, our luxury hotel bar is the perfect spot for pre or post-show drinks. Our signature cocktail menu is a celebration of London’s vibrant theatre scene, drawing inspiration from productions including The Phantom of the Opera, playing across the road at His Majesty’s Theatre. We also serve an extensive wine list. On Wednesdays and Thursdays, enjoy live jazz performances from 5:30pm - 7:30pm.
Do you have any private event spaces available for hire?
Yes, we have a selection of flexible and stylish event spaces available in London's West End at Haymarket Hotel. There are private dining rooms for special celebrations and creative meeting spaces for corporate events, as well as showstopping spaces including an underground swimming pool and bar. From birthday parties to chic city weddings, we can accommodate both intimate gatherings and larger functions.
Explore our spaces here .
What is there to do near Haymarket Hotel during my stay?
Located in London’s West End, Haymarket Hotel is the perfect place from which to explore the city, with top landmarks and cultural attractions on your doorstep. Some of our highlights include:
Theatres : Our luxury boutique hotel is surrounded by London’s top theatres, including His Majesty’s Theatre opposite Brumus and Theatre Royal Haymarket, just next door. A short walk away you can also find The Harold Pinter Theatre, Wyndham’s Theatre and Garrick Theatre.
Landmarks : Haymarket Hotel is situated less than a 5-minute walk from Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus and Trafalgar Square.
Galleries : The National Gallery and National Portrait Gallery can be accessed within 5 minutes.
Shopping : Browse high-street brands on Regent Street. For a spot of luxury shopping, head to Mayfair, home to the beautiful Fortnum & Mason store as well as boutiques tucked inside Burlington Arcade.
Green Spaces : Two spacious central London parks, St James’s Park and Green Park, are within easy walking distance, perfect for unwinding during a summer stay in London.
What are the closest stations to Haymarket Hotel?
Piccadilly Circus, Charing Cross and Leicester Square underground stations are all located near Haymarket Hotel:
Piccadilly Circus: 5-minute walk
Charing Cross: 6-minute walk
Leicester Square: 8-minute walk
From tales of design to exclusive events, and seasonal menus, our Haymarket Hotel newsletters are brimming with stories for the curious and the creative.
